title: ADT named to Forbes’ America’s Best Employers for Women 2026 list
summary: Forbes has recognized ADT for fostering an environment where women can grow, lead and build careers on its Best Employers for Women list.
body_markdown:
ADT, the leader in smart home security solutions, has been named to[Forbes’ America’s Best Employers for Women 2026](https://www.forbes.com/lists/best-employers-women/) list, an annual recognition honoring U.S. companies that are creating environments where women can advance professionally, pursue leadership opportunities and thrive throughout their careers.


Developed by Forbes and market research firm Statista, the list draws on feedback from more than 146,000 women employed by organizations with at least 1,000 employees nationwide. Participants evaluated employers across a range of workplace experiences, including career growth, compensation, parental leave, work-life balance and support programs for caregivers.


Researchers also considered the representation of women in leadership and governance roles when determining the final list.


"This recognition reflects the kind of workplace we're building every day at ADT," said Tiffany Galarza, ADT's VP of Technology Operations and Executive Chair of ADT’s Women's Business Employee Resource Group. "We want women to see opportunities for themselves here, whether they're just starting their careers, growing into new roles or stepping into leadership positions. Creating those opportunities is both a business and cultural priority for us, and it's key to building a stronger workforce and future."


The annual list highlights organizations that receive positive feedback from women employees and invest in workplace practices that support long-term success and advancement.
